Compute a distance matrix for cluster analysis

Source: R/seg_prep.R
seg_distance.Rd

Thin wrapper around factoextra::get_dist() and cluster::daisy() with a common interface. Usually called via seg_prep_data(), but can be used on its own on already prepared (e.g. standardized) data.

Usage

seg_distance(
  x,
  distance = "euclidean",
  distance_engine = c("auto", "get_dist", "daisy"),
  labels = NULL,
  daisy_args = list()
)

Arguments

x

A data frame or numeric matrix with the (prepared) clustering variables.

distance

Distance measure, see seg_prep_data().

distance_engine

"auto", "get_dist" or "daisy", see seg_prep_data().

labels

Optional vector of labels for the observations (length nrow(x)), used as labels of the distance matrix.

daisy_args

A list of further arguments passed to cluster::daisy().

Value

A distance matrix of class dist (for "daisy" additionally of class dissimilarity).

Examples

x <- scale(datasets::USArrests)
d <- seg_distance(x, distance = "manhattan")
d_gower <- seg_distance(datasets::USArrests, distance = "gower")
